item.text: {"rubric":[{"claim_id":"c1","claim_type":"core","weight":25,"statement":"The program constructs two `dspy.Signature` types whose field names and field metadata match, while only the `answer` output annotation differs between `int` and `str`.","span_ids":["s2","s5"]},{"claim_id":"c2","claim_type":"core","weight":30,"statement":"It inspects the output field metadata and verifies at runtime that the two `answer` fields really carry different annotations (`int` versus `str`).","span_ids":["s2","s4"]},{"claim_id":"c3","claim_type":"core","weight":35,"statement":"It verifies that calling `.equals` on those two signatures returns `True`, demonstrating that an annotation-only change does not affect `Signature.equals`.","span_ids":["s5"]},{"claim_id":"c4","claim_type":"supporting","weight":10,"statement":"It keeps the signatures' instructions identical, either explicitly or by relying on the shared default instructions derived from the same field names, so the equality result isolates the type-only change.","span_ids":["s1","s3","s5"]}],"evidence":[{"span_id":"s1","path":"dspy/signatures/signature.py","start_line":35,"end_line":38},{"span_id":"s2","path":"dspy/signatures/signature.py","start_line":138,"end_line":177},{"span_id":"s3","path":"dspy/signatures/signature.py","start_line":179,"end_line":191},{"span_id":"s4","path":"dspy/signatures/signature.py","start_line":223,"end_line":244},{"span_id":"s5","path":"dspy/signatures/signature.py","start_line":473,"end_line":484}]}
